messages:
maya_cs: Kicking off Bluehaven week0 onboarding thread. Three items blocking go-live: KMS key approval (ticket CS-9102) awaiting BYOK approval, outbound egress to partner CIDR blocked, and audit events not appearing in their Splunk HEC. Can infra/security/ops pick owners?

 tom_se: Noted. Security asked about BYOK provenance — they need attestation that the key material was generated in the customer's HSM and a fingerprint. If Bluehaven can't provide attestation we can offer Redwood-managed KMS with a restricted key policy.

 lina_infra: For egress I'll need exact CIDR+ports and the list of private subnets to scope the rule. We prefer creating a stateful egress rule limited to app subnets only. Also confirm whether traffic should go via NAT GW or a dedicated egress VPC endpoint.

 maya_cs: Customer provided partner endpoints: 198.51.100.0/24 port 443 (API), 198.51.101.0/28 port 8088 (Splunk HEC). They prefer traffic via NAT GW. Subnets: private-1a, private-1b.

 claire_security: Key policy guidance: if BYOK, we need key origin attestation and to include explicit encryption/decryption conditions that restrict use to the redwood service principal arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-runtime. Also deny key usage if requestMetadata.source != "priv-deploy". I'll draft minimal policy and post to CS-9102. Note: BYOK may introduce compliance review delay ~48h.

 javier_ops: On Splunk HEC, common blockers: missing HEC token, HEC requiring self-signed CA not trusted by our forwarder, or network path blocked. Quick validation curl (replace <TOKEN>):

 ```
 curl -v -X POST "https://splunk.bluehaven.example:8088/services/collector/event" \
   -H "Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"event":"test event"}'
 ```

 If that returns 204 we're good. If TLS handshake fails, forwarder needs the CA chain. Also verify VPC Flow Logs are landing in s3://bluehaven-logs/flow/ and CloudTrail entries exist for PutObject to the bucket.

 deploybot: priv-deploy/bluehaven v1.2.0 smoke started at 2819993360. status: partial-success. failed-tests: kms-policy,audit-forwarding

 lina_infra: I queued change request cr-998 to add egress from private-1a/private-1b to 198.51.100.0/24:443 and 198.51.101.0/28:8088 via NAT GW ngw-44f. ETA ~6m to propagate.

 maya_cs: Bluehaven asked whether Redwood creates the IAM role in our account or in theirs for cross-account S3 reads. They prefer we read from their bucket. What's recommended?

 tom_se: Best practice: customer creates role in their account that trusts our read-only role arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-log-reader. That avoids us needing write permissions in their account. I'll prepare CFN for them. Example trust snippet I'll attach.

 claire_security: Also confirm S3 bucket policy allows the cross-account role s3:GetObject on the logs prefix and that SSE-KMS header matches the chosen key alias. If they use SSE-KMS with BYOK we need the KMS ARN in the bucket policy condition.

 javier_ops: After CR propagation I'll run Splunk curl test and forwarder smoke. Will post logs.

 lina_infra: CR cr-998 shows active. Please retry after 5m.

 javier_ops: Ran curl at 2819993392. Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized — HEC token rejected. Forwarder log shows "missing or invalid token". Pasting snippet into CS-9102.

 maya_cs: I relayed to customer — they regenerated token and will confirm when rotated. Also asked them to provide KMS attestation doc. Reminder from AM: onboarding velocity flagged as a renewal sensitivity. If KMS BYOK + audit ingestion not confirmed within 7 business days escalate to AM + finance. Marking renewal-risk if unresolved by 2820009400.

 tom_se: CFN snippet for cross-account role (customer side) I'll post to ticket CS-9102 by EOD. Example: 

 ```
 Type: AWS::IAM::Role
 Properties:
   RoleName: bluehaven-logs-reader
   AssumeRolePolicyDocument: |
     {
       "Version": "2012-10-17",
       "Statement": [
         {
           "Effect": "Allow",
           "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-log-reader" },
           "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
         }
       ]
     }
   Policies:
     - PolicyName: ReadS3Logs
       PolicyDocument: |
         {
           "Statement": [
             {
               "Effect": "Allow",
               "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
               "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::bluehaven-logs","arn:aws:s3:::bluehaven-logs/*"]
             }
           ]
         }
 ```

 claire_security: I'll review CFN and add the KMS ARN condition if BYOK is used.

 javier_ops: After token rotation I retried at 2819993401. Response: HTTP/1.1 204 No Content — accepted. Forwarder logs show events received. Uploading artifacts to CS-9102.

 deploybot: Reminder scheduled follow-up 2820070000 (week1 check). reaction :spiral_calendar:

 maya_cs: Action items: @tom_se post CFN + role guidance; @claire_security finalize KMS key policy and note BYOK delay; @lina_infra confirm CR persisted and attach cr-998; @javier_ops monitor Splunk intake for 24h and upload evidence; I'll review renewal board tomorrow AM and flag if not stable. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
